options.content:
### Verify dashboard data

If a KPI is empty or looks incomplete, check the capture path in order: [scrape target](https://github.com/aibudaevv/sip-exporter/blob/develop/docs/INSTALLATION.md#verify-scrape) → [SIP capture](https://github.com/aibudaevv/sip-exporter/blob/develop/docs/INSTALLATION.md#verify-sip) → [dialog, SDP, and RTP visibility](https://github.com/aibudaevv/sip-exporter/blob/develop/docs/INSTALLATION.md#verify-dialog-sdp) → [socket and userspace drops](https://github.com/aibudaevv/sip-exporter/blob/develop/docs/INSTALLATION.md#verify-drops). Do not diagnose QoE until the preceding checks are healthy.

panels.title: Verify dashboard data
panels.description: Verify scrape, SIP capture, SDP/RTP visibility, and drops before diagnosing empty or incomplete KPIs.

panels.title: Active Sessions
panels.description: Operational view of Active Sessions. Scope with dashboard filters; No data means the selected traffic was not observed.

panels.title: RTP Userspace Drops/s
panels.description: RTP packets dropped by exporter userspace per current interval. Investigate capture capacity before treating media KPIs as complete.

panels.title: INVITE Rate
panels.description: Operational view of INVITE Rate. Scope with dashboard filters; No data means the selected traffic was not observed.

panels.title: Completed Sessions/sec
panels.description: Operational view of Completed Sessions/sec. Scope with dashboard filters; No data means the selected traffic was not observed.

panels.title: PDD p95 (Post Dial Delay)
panels.description: 95th percentile exporter-observed SIP INVITE to 180 Ringing delay for the current interval. It is not a measure of first media or user-perceived ringback.

panels.title: Median Session Duration
panels.description: Median completed-session duration for the current interval. It is not ACD and long calls are not inherently unhealthy.

panels.title: ASR (Answer Seizure Ratio)
panels.description: Operational view of ASR (Answer Seizure Ratio). Scope with dashboard filters; No data means the selected traffic was not observed.

panels.title: NER (Network Effectiveness Ratio)
panels.description: Network Effectiveness Ratio for the current interval. Interface and Destination Country filters do not apply because failure counters do not carry those labels.

panels.title: RTP Packet Loss %
panels.description: Wire-observed RTP sequence loss for SDP-correlated streams. No data until RTP is observed; validate capture drops before diagnosing the network.

panels.title: RTP MOS
panels.description: Average E-model MOS for SDP-correlated RTP. No data until RTP is observed; it is a network estimate at the capture point, not an endpoint opinion.

panels.title: Socket Drop %
panels.description: Kernel AF_PACKET loss. A non-zero value means captured SIP/RTP data may be incomplete.

panels.title: Missing RTP Dialogs/s
panels.description: Completed dialogs without SDP-correlated RTP, per current interval. Verify SDP visibility and capture topology before treating it as a call failure.

panels.description: Wire-observed RTP for SDP-correlated media at the capture point. Check Socket Drop % and exporter drops before using it for network diagnosis; No data means no correlated RTP.

targets.expr: sum by (carrier, ua_type, source_country, codec) (rate(sip_exporter_rtp_mos_score_sum{instance=~"$instance",carrier=~"$carrier",direction=~"$direction",ua_type=~"$ua_type",source_country=~"$source_country"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (carrier, ua_type, source_country, codec) (rate(sip_exporter_rtp_mos_score_count{instance=~"$instance",carrier=~"$carrier",direction=~"$direction",ua_type=~"$ua_type",source_country=~"$source_country"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Wire-observed RTP for SDP-correlated media at the capture point. Check Socket Drop % and exporter drops before using it for network diagnosis; No data means no correlated RTP.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, carrier, ua_type, source_country, codec) (rate(sip_exporter_rtp_jitter_milliseconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",carrier=~"$carrier",direction=~"$direction",ua_type=~"$ua_type",source_country=~"$source_country"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: RTCP Round-Trip Time p95 (endpoint-reported)
panels.description: Endpoint-reported RTCP quality from correlated RTP streams. No data can mean endpoints do not send SR/RR, not that media is healthy; orphan reports indicate correlation gaps.

panels.description: Compares wire-observed RTP jitter with endpoint-reported RTCP jitter when both are available. RTCP no data is expected for endpoints that do not send reports.
